messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v4.8.0 -> target group 'serving-eu' at 6% traffic. rollout_id=r-369001. change-window 2026-05-28T03:00Z-04:00Z.
harper: release notes posted? need the support snippet.
release-bot: Notes: https://release.redwood.com/4.8.0 • highlights: kvcache safety, batching backpressure, tokenization fix.
mike: watching eu telemetry. will flag if anything odd.
sana: eu-west-2 shows a p95 jump on embeddings at 03:05Z (140ms -> 310ms) and sampled 5xx ~0.7%. not uniform across AZs.
infra-bot: Alert: eu-west-2 embed 5xx > 0.5% over 5m. Paging oncall.
harper: prefer regional containment. options: throttle eu to 1% and run smoke, or pin affected AZs back to v4.7.9.
mike: throttle to 1% first. command: `deployctl adjust --id r-369001 --region eu --percent 1`
deploy-bot: Adjusting rollout r-369001: region eu target percent -> 1%... done.
sana: after throttle, errors fell to 0.12% in 4m, but one host still returning 502s for /v1/embeddings. logs point to memory pressure during cache restore.
harper: cadence: keep eu at 1% for 20m. if errors exceed 0.5% for 10m, expand pin to full region. can we AZ-pin instead to minimize impact?
mike: yes AZ-level pin suggested. command: `releasectl pin --region eu-west-2 --az az-b,az-d --version v4.7.9`
sana: applying AZ pin now.
deploy-bot: releasectl: pin applied for eu-west-2 az-b,az-d -> v4.7.9.
release-bot: Deploy history note: eu region throttled to 1%; eu-west-2 az-b,d pinned to v4.7.9; global rollout paused in eu.
harper: customer blurb: "Partial hold in Europe: a subset of hosts in eu-west-2 rolled back to v4.7.9 due to cache warmup regression; rollout continues at reduced rate elsewhere."
infra-bot: Support blurb queued and sent to #support.
mike: running extended smoke and will monitor 95/99 latencies and 5xx for 30m.
sana: if hotfix ready, we'll canary it in eu-north-1 at 0.5% and then lift.
harper: agreed. follow-up: add kvcache-config alignment to preflight and document AZ pin decision in postmortem if we expand. thanks all. :thumbsup:
